lang_en:
I wanted my parents' first trip with me to be Leh, in November.
Mummy asked if it would be hard on them, so I looked it up properly.
NakshIQ had a note for older travellers, and Leh was a hard no for heart or lung conditions.
Even fit people their age needed three days to acclimatise, and November there was a skip.
Udaipur was very suitable, a flat old city with lifts in most heritage hotels, and November a go.
So we walked the old city slowly, and the only climbing was in a lift.
Travel intelligence is planning for whoever is actually coming.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
मैं चाहता था कि मम्मी-पापा के साथ मेरी पहली ट्रिप लेह हो, नवंबर में।
मम्मी ने पूछा कि उनके लिए मुश्किल तो नहीं होगी, तो मैंने ठीक से देखा।
NakshIQ पर बुज़ुर्गों के लिए अलग नोट था, और दिल या फेफड़ों की तकलीफ़ वालों के लिए लेह साफ़ मना था।
फ़िट लोगों को भी वहाँ की हवा की आदत डालने में तीन दिन लगते, और नवंबर तो वहाँ स्किप ही था।
उदयपुर बिल्कुल सही था, पुराना शहर समतल, ज़्यादातर हेरिटेज होटलों में लिफ़्ट, और नवंबर भी गो।
तो हम पुराने शहर में आराम से घूमे, और चढ़ाई सिर्फ़ लिफ़्ट में हुई।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है उनके हिसाब से प्लान करना जो सच में साथ आ रहे हैं।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: I wanted my parents' first trip with me | to be *Leh, in November*.

facts.quote: Hard no at 3524m for anyone with cardiac/pulmonary conditions
For fit 55–65 year olds: possible with 3-day acclimatization before any excursion

shots: A son in his 30s and his parents in their 60s sit at a home dining table in the evening, a laptop open, seen from behind.
The mother's hands rest on the table beside the laptop while the son scrolls, faces out of frame.
Evening in Udaipur's old city: the three walk slowly down an empty flat lane of pale old houses, seen from behind.
The father and mother step into a small heritage hotel lift with an old metal grille, the son holding the door, shot from the side.
The parents stand at a stone balcony looking out over a still lake at dusk, backs to camera.
Wide shot of the three walking along the empty lakeside path at dusk, small in the frame.
